[SWS_DM_01208] Authentication State Change Notifier
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04240
⌈
If the application calls the method
ara::diag::ClientAuthentication::Set-
Notifier
of the class
ara::diag::ClientAuthentication
, the
Diagnostic
Server instance
shall call the passed notifier-function whenever there is a change
in the Authentication State of the client.
⌋
